items.source: Create a table with the name given and fields corresponding to the given class. If the table already exists and parameter ifNotExists is true, this is a no-op and false is returned. If the table doesn't exist, parameter ifNotExists is ignored, the table is created and true is returned.
items.translation: 创建一个表，其名称为给定值，字段对应于给定的类。如果表已存在且参数 ifNotExists 为 true，则此操作无效果并返回 false。如果表不存在，则忽略参数 ifNotExists，创建该表并返回 true。
